messages:
alex: Quick heads-up — planning ExternalSecrets upgrade to v0.7 on staging tomorrow 09:00 PT. Main change: SecretStore CRD field rename (vault -> secretstore) and rotation annotation rename. Looking for config review and any gotchas.

maria: Thanks. Which CRs will change? Can you paste the minimal diff?

alex: Pasted config snippet below — small TF + helm tweak. Also will change annotation from `externalsecrets.io/ttl` -> `secrets.redwood.com/rotation-ttl` per v0.7.

alex: ```yaml
# old
apiVersion: external-secrets.io/v1beta1
kind: ExternalSecret
metadata:
  name: payment-svc-keys
  annotations:
    externalsecrets.io/ttl: "3600"
spec:
  secretStoreRef:
    name: vault-global
    kind: ClusterSecretStore
  target:
    name: payment-keys
    creationPolicy: Owner
  data:
  - secretKey: api_key
    remoteRef:
      key: secret/data/payment/api
```

alex: ```yaml
# new
apiVersion: external-secrets.io/v1beta1
kind: ExternalSecret
metadata:
  name: payment-svc-keys
  annotations:
    secrets.redwood.com/rotation-ttl: "3600"
spec:
  secretStoreRef:
    name: secretstore-vault
    kind: ClusterSecretStore
  target:
    name: payment-keys
    creationPolicy: Owner
  data:
  - secretKey: api_key
    remoteRef:
      key: secret/data/payment/api
```

sam: tf note — in our tf module `externalsecret` I changed provider attr `vault_name` -> `store_name` last week. We need to bump module usage in infra repo. I can PR.

lee: Also watch for template paths: some services reference `vault/global` path; the new store name is `secretstore-vault` so update role bindings if we rely on names.

maria: One runtime gotcha: KV engine version mismatch can cause failed fetches with 4xx. Add a small smoke job post-upgrade: `curl /v1/secret/data/...` from vault-proxy. 

jen: Pinged @oncall about rollout window. Can we do a canary for a single namespace first (staging -> staging-canary)?

alex: Yes — plan: rollout to staging-canary (10% of pods) then full staging. Deploy bot will post release once PR merged.

devops-bot: deploy scheduled: external-secrets:v0.7 -> staging-canary at 2026-03-19T16:00:00Z by alex

sam: PR: https://git.internal/r/infra/+/1234 update module usage + helm values (values.externalSecrets.storeName)

maria: Quick review — LGTM but add migration note in the helm values docs about annotation rename and TF attr rename.

lee: One more: ensure our RBAC binding to `system:auth` for the secret retrieval is still valid; the controller's serviceAccount name changed in v0.7.

alex: Good catch, will include SA rename in PR.

jen: After the canary, I'll run the smoke script and report back.

jen: :thumbsup:

alex: thanks everyone. I'll merge PR at 09:00 PT and coordinate with oncall. If issues, rollback to v0.6 via helm rollback.

sam: note for rollback: keep old helm revision pinned in staging until we confirm rotation jobs done (avoid double-rotation)

maria: ack

jen: I'll post results in this thread after smoke.
